dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see your newborn has some yellowish discoloration; when exactly did you first notice this yellowing of the skin?
It started just yesterday, doctor. First I noticed it on his face, but then it seemed to spread down to his chest and tummy.
He’s also got that same yellow color in the whites of his eyes. Other than that, he’s been eating well and his diapers seem normal.

How many days old is your baby today, and was he born full-term or a bit early? Also, are you breastfeeding or using formula?

REQUEST TEST: Total_Serum_Bilirubin
Thank you for that level. Could you please tell me exactly how many hours or days old he is now, and what are your and the baby's blood types? I would also
He is five days old today. I'm not sure about our blood types, but he was born right on time at 38 weeks without any issues.

What color are his bowel movements, and has anyone in the family ever had issues with jaundice or blood disorders? I would also like to check his blood compatibility.

REQUEST TEST: Coombs_Test
Since the Coombs test is normal, we can rule out certain blood type incompatibilities. Could you tell me if his stools are a pale clay color or a normal yellow/mustard color
His stools look like a normal mustard color to me. There hasn't been any change in his bowel movements or his wet diapers since he was born.

Has anyone in your family had a history of liver issues or blood conditions like G6PD deficiency? I'd like to check the breakdown of his bilirubin levels as well.

REQUEST TEST: Direct_Bilirubin

Is he exclusively breastfed, or does he receive any formula? Also, did he have any bruising or a lump on his head after birth?

REQUEST TEST: Reticulocyte_
He is eating well, but is he exclusively breastfed or taking formula? I'd also like to know if there's any family history of blood disorders or if he had any bruising during birth.
He's been exclusively breastfed every two to three hours since he was born. There's no family history of blood disorders that I know of, and he didn't have any bruising or issues during the delivery.

It sounds like he is doing very well overall with his feeding and activity. Has he been particularly sleepy or difficult to wake for his feedings lately? 

DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice
